# AMEVA-MCP-Hub Full Technical Specification (v3.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Zero-Install Universal Polyglot WASM & AI Vector Model Context Protocol Hub
Executes WASI WebAssembly bytecodes in-memory inside a single Node process (<1ms execution) and enables live multi-repo subscription for AI tools.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: 
- Command: npx ameva-mcp-hub
# or as SDK:
npm install ameva-mcp-hub
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-mcp-hub

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 0-Drift Output**: Bit-exact floating-point precision verified across heterogeneous ARM64 & WebGPU hardware.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Architecture**: Operates 100% on the local client without external network telemetry leaks.
- **Memory Leakage Protection**: Weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM / system RAM leaks.
